title: The rupee in 2026: a record slide, then a rebound
dek: From near 89 to the dollar in January to a record low near 96.90, then a rebound in November. What moved the rupee this year.
seoTitle: Rupee vs dollar 2026: record lows and the rebound
bigLabel: Rupees per US dollar in early trade on 13 Nov, from a record low near 96.90

glance.what: The rupee hit a string of record lows in 2026, bottoming near 96.90 per dollar. Since October it has recovered more than 3%, reaching a six-month high of 93.70 on 9 November.
glance.why: A weaker rupee makes imports like oil, electronics and foreign travel or education more expensive, and adds to inflation.
glance.next: Falling oil prices, foreign inflows and RBI dollar sales are helping. A renewed oil spike would reverse that.

forYou: Anything priced in dollars costs more: foreign trips, overseas tuition, imported gadgets. Families receiving money from abroad get more rupees per dollar or dirham.
next: Watch oil prices and foreign investor flows.

events.title: First record low of the year
events.summary: The rupee weakens toward 91.7 per dollar as foreign investors sell Indian stocks.

events.title: Past 92 as war in West Asia lifts oil
events.summary: Soaring oil prices and fighting in the Gulf push the rupee past 92 for the first time.

events.title: A lifetime low of 93.96
events.summary: Global uncertainty drives the rupee to a new record.

events.title: Through 96 as oil surges
events.summary: The rupee hits 96.25 in early trade after closing below 96 for the first time the previous Friday. Foreign investors pulled nearly $20 billion from Indian equities in the first four months of 2026.

events.title: Hovering near record lows ahead of the RBI decision
events.summary: The rupee trades around 96.4 per dollar. The RBI keeps selling dollars to slow the fall, and markets price in a rate hike.

events.title: RBI steps in; the rupee turns
events.summary: After the RBI sells dollars and tightens currency rules, the rupee rises nearly 1% in October, one of Asia's best performers that month, and settles around 94.46 on 5 November.

events.title: A six-month high of 93.70
events.summary: The rupee touches 93.70 per dollar in early trade, its strongest in about six months, as crude falls and foreign money flows back in. It has recovered more than 3% from its record low near 96.90, and closes the day at 93.93.

events.title: A small pullback from the high
events.summary: The rupee slips 41 paise to close at 94.12 on 12 November as the dollar strengthens, then edges up to 94.05 in early trade on 13 November on foreign inflows and softer oil. One forex adviser still sees the broader trend favouring the rupee.
